title: KV cache in decoding
subject: Key-value caching in autoregressive transformer inference
summary:
A decoder generates one token at a time. Without a cache, every step recomputes keys and values for the whole prefix. The KV cache stores each layer's keys and values once, so each new step only computes them for the newest token.

This turns per-step attention projection cost from O(n) tokens to O(1) tokens, at the price of memory that grows with sequence length.
limits: Simplified to one sequence. Batching, paging (vLLM PagedAttention), and quantized caches are mentioned only in notes.

metadata.summary: Each layer multiplies hidden states by three weight matrices to get queries, keys, and values for every prompt token.
metadata.formula:
Q = X·W_q   K = X·W_k   V = X·W_v
shape per layer: [n, kv_heads, head_dim]

nodes.title: KV cache
nodes.subtitle: K and V kept per layer

metadata.summary: Keys and values for all past tokens, stored per layer. Queries are not stored because only the newest query is ever needed.
metadata.details: Size grows linearly with tokens. For a 32-layer model with 8 KV heads of dim 128 in fp16: 2 × 32 × 8 × 128 × 2 bytes = 128 KiB per token, so 1,000 tokens use about 125 MiB.
metadata.formula: bytes = 2 · L · kv_heads · head_dim · dtype_bytes · tokens
metadata.example: L=32, kv_heads=8, head_dim=128, fp16, 1000 tokens → ≈125 MiB
gotchas: Grouped-query attention (fewer KV heads than query heads) shrinks this cache; multi-head attention does not.

metadata.summary: Full causal self-attention over the prompt. This is compute-bound and runs once.
The token sampled at the previous step becomes the only new input.
Compute q, k, v for the new token only. Append k and v to the cache.
metadata.formula:
q,k,v = x_t·W_{q,k,v}
K ← concat(K, k)   V ← concat(V, v)

metadata.summary: The single query attends over every cached key. This step is memory-bandwidth bound: the GPU reads the whole cache each step.
gotchas: Long contexts make decode slower per token because the cache read grows, even though projection cost is constant.
notes: PagedAttention stores the cache in fixed-size blocks to avoid fragmentation.

metadata.summary: Final layer output becomes logits; sampling picks the next token. Stop on EOS or max tokens, else loop.
Detokenized output returned to the caller.
